title: 4/01 compute tiers failed: predict-json stdout carried log lines (Mac 'Invalid JSON output'); Alienware build_season crashed on cp1252
tier_reason: liveness failure of the only prediction path: the projected-lineup NOTE (link 2) went to stdout on every tier whenever any team used a projected lineup, so the orchestrator cascade could not return predictions before lineups posted (inference from code); the Mac tier's live failure and the Alienware crash are reported contemporaneously; whether a scheduled run consequently made no pick is not evidenced

contract.text: Each compute tier's bts predict-json writes only the JSON prediction payload to stdout and completes on its host platform, so the orchestrator cascade can use the first healthy tier.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md at 4442873 ('predict-json — worker command: runs pipeline, outputs JSON to stdout, logs to stderr'); src/bts/cli.py predict_json docstring 'All log messages go to stderr' (1929f5a)

mechanism.text: b6b1865 made every predict-json run refresh the season first; pull_feeds printed its skip/fail lines to stdout, so the payload was no longer pure JSON and ssh_predict rejected it ('Invalid JSON output')

_fetch_game_slots printed 'NOTE: N teams using projected lineups' to stdout (present since ab3db97, before predict-json existed), contaminating the payload on every tier whenever a projected lineup was used

the refresh's build_season and enrich_weather read and wrote feed JSON with the platform default encoding; on Windows (cp1252) accented player names raised charmap errors and the Alienware tier crashed

residual.text: worker tiers ran whatever checkout they had until 5207a09 (4/04) made them git pull origin main before each predict-json, so a pushed fix reached a tier only on a manual pull (I-104)

watchdog.trigger: a scheduled prediction run ends with every compute tier failed (orchestrator 'All compute tiers failed' or no predictions saved) while a game is still pickable
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a later run on the same day returns predictions and a pick is committed before the earliest pickable cutoff, or the day is alerted as missed

evidence.what: pull_feeds printed skip/fail messages to stdout, contaminating predict-json's JSON output; fixes the Mac tier failing with 'Invalid JSON output'
'projected lineup NOTE was going to stdout, breaking predict-json'
Windows defaults to cp1252; accented player names caused charmap errors; fixes the Alienware build_season crash

evidence.locator: src/bts/orchestrator.py orchestrate/run_cascade at b6b1865; src/bts/model/predict.py _fetch_game_slots NOTE print (added ab3db97, 3/29); predict-json added 2bb3234 (3/31 23:32 ET)
evidence.what: a tier returning non-JSON counts as failed; when every tier fails, orchestrate DMs 'All compute tiers failed. No pick made.' and makes no pick
first successful deploy run whose head (4a82cf8) contains the three fixes; a Fly.io deploy, log expired
